c01-luis-jacket.observed_description: Luis stands full length in front of a light-brick apartment building in a short black zip jacket over his navy T-shirt, khaki trousers and white sneakers.
c01-luis-jacket.note: Usable: the black jacket is the clear piece; he wears no red shirt, hat or scarf.

c02-sofia-dress.observed_description: Sofia stands full length in a garden in a bright blue knee-length dress and white sandals.
c02-sofia-dress.note: Usable: the blue dress reads at 180 px; no skirt, jacket or hat.

c03-ana-skirt.observed_description: Ana stands full length on a tree-lined street in a green knee-length skirt, a white T-shirt and brown flats.
c03-ana-skirt.note: Usable: the green skirt reads at 180 px; no dress or jacket.

c04-diego-shirt.observed_description: Diego stands full length in a bright living room in a red button shirt with rolled sleeves, jeans and brown shoes.
c04-diego-shirt.note: Usable: the red shirt reads at 180 px; no jacket.
